parts.label: (a)
parts.text: State what is meant by the specific acoustic impedance of a medium.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
A parallel beam of ultrasound of intensity $I_0$ is incident on the boundary between two media A and B, as illustrated in Fig. 4.1.

{{figure:figure_4_1}}

The two media A and B have specific acoustic impedances $Z_A$ and $Z_B$ respectively. The intensity of the beam transmitted through the boundary is $I_T$.

State how the ratio

$$\frac{\text{intensity } I_{\text{T}} \text{ of transmitted beam}}{\text{intensity } I_0 \text{ of incident beam}}$$

depends on the relative magnitudes of $Z_A$ and $Z_B$.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text:
The linear absorption (attenuation) coefficient $\mu$ of medium B is $23\text{ m}^{-1}$.

Calculate the thickness of medium B required to reduce the intensity of the ultrasound beam to 34% of its initial intensity in medium B.
